m: शाणी (ई), f., see below.
शाणी f. a hempen cloth or garment, MBh.
ragged or torn raiment, the tattered clothes of a Jain ascetic, L.
a single breadth of cloth given to a student at his investiture, W.
a small tent or screen, ib.
gesture, gesticulation, ib.
a: शाणी — 1 A touchstone. --2 A whetstone. --3 A saw. --4 A hempen garment. --5 A ragged garment. --6 A small screen or tent. --7 Gesticulation, a sign made with the hands or eyes. --8 A weight of four Māṣas.

m: शाणीर n. = शणीर, L.
a: शाणीरं — A bank or spot of ground in the Śoṇa river.

m: 1. शाण m. (or f(आ). ; fr. √ शो cf. शान) a whetstone, grindstone, touchstone, Kāv.; Rājat.
a saw, L.
2. शाण m. (or f(आ). ) a weight of four Māṣas, Hariv.; Bhpr.
3. शाण mf(ई)n. (fr. शण) made of hemp or Bengal flax, hempen, flaxen, ŚBr. &c. &c.
शाण m. or n. a hempen garment, Gaut.
a: शाण — a. (णी f.) [शणेन निर्वृत्तं अण्] Hempen, flaxen. --णः 1 A touchstone; मणिः शाणो ल्लीढः Bh. 2. 44; Bv. 1. 73. --2 A whetstone. --3 A saw. --4 A weight of four Māṣas. --णं 1 Sack-cloth, coarse cloth. --2 A hempen garment; Ms. 2. 41, 10. 87. --Comp. --आजीवः an armourer.

k.v: नाराची स्यादेषणिका शाणस्तु निकषः कषः। व्रश्चनःपत्रपरशुरीषिका तूलिका समे॥

शाण्डिली f. See next.

m: शाण्डिल्य mfn. derived from or composed by Śāṇḍilya &c., Cat.
शाण्डिल्य m. patr. fr. शण्डिल, g. गर्गादि

N. of various teachers, authors &c. (esp. of a Muni or sage from whom one of the three principal families of the Kanouj or Kānyakubja Brāhmans is said to be descended; he is the author of a law-book and of the Bhakti-sūtra or aphorisms enjoining ‘love or devotion to God’ as one of the three means of salvation — a doctrine said to have been formulated in the 12th century; see भक्ति, RTL. 63)
of Agni, Hariv.
Aegle Marmelos, Bhpr.
शाण्डिल्य n. N. of various works of Śāṇḍilya (esp. = -सूत्र and = ˚ल्योपनिषद्).
